card.name: Cephalosporin and carbapenem label text
card.fires_on: Mixed spots in antibiotic labels (AVYCAZ, CONTEPO, VABOMERE): inside brand names, after numeric ranges, and before a number in dose or patient-group text.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of antibiotic brand names such as AVYCAZ and CONTEPO.

modes.label: Spaces in number ranges
modes.description: The space after 'to' or 'than' just before a number in age, renal or dosing ranges.
